steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event create flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ pricing stage.
Apply the pricing template required for the RFQ sheet.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor for the submission.
Publish the event so the vendor can submit a bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Verify the buyer initially has no vendor response.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Assert that the buyer now sees exactly one direct vendor response and the participation count increased to one.
